passive.name: Game Changer
passive.text:
Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer enters combat or uses Ultimate on an ally target, the wearer gains "Great Fortune" for **3** turn(s). While the wearer holds "Great Fortune," all allies' CRIT Rate increases by **10/11/12/13/14%**, CRIT DMG increases by **30/37.5/45/52.5/60%**, and the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by **12/14/16/18/20%**.
At the start of each wave, the wearer regenerates a fixed amount of **15** Energy.

passive.name: Rumble
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by **6/7/8/9/10%** for **2** turn(s).

substatLine: SPD (as much as possible) > CRIT Rate > CRIT DMG
tracePriority: Poised and Sated (A4) > Amaze-In Grace (A2) > Felicity Ensemble (A6)

entries.name: Whistlebolt Sings Joy
entries.text: Deals Physical DMG equal to **90%** of Yao Guang's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to **30%** of Yao Guang's ATK to targets adjacent to it. The Energy regenerated from Basic ATK increases to 30.

entries.name: Decalight Unveils All
entries.text: Deploys a Zone for **3** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of this unit's every turn. While the Zone is active, increases all allies' Elation by an amount equal to **20%** of Yao Guang's Elation. After Yao Guang uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains **3** Punchline.

entries.name: Hexagram of Feathered Fortune
entries.text: Gains **5** Punchline. Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn where a fixed amount of **20** Punchline is taken into account. This turn does not consume Punchline, and increases all allies' All-Type RES PEN by **20%** for **3** turn(s).

entries.name: Behold Wherever Light Unfolds
entries.text:
While Yao Guang holds "Certified Banger":
After an ally target uses an attack, triggers the "Great Boon" effect, dealing 1 additional instance of **20%** Elation DMG of the corresponding Type to 1 random hit target. If this attack consumes Skill Points, then additionally triggers "Great Boon" 1 time.
When triggering the "Great Boon" effect, if the attacker's Elation is lower than that of Yao Guang, then this instance of Elation DMG will take Yao Guang's Elation into calculation.
Triggering the "Great Boon" effect is not considered as using 1 instance of attack.

entries.name: Untethered Glimmer Sails Far
entries.text: After using Technique, automatically triggers Skill 1 time at the start of the next battle without consuming any Skill Points. When Yao Guang is in the team, breaking destructible objects immediately grants Fortune Pouch, up to **8** within every Earth Week.

entries.name: Let Thy Fortune Burst in Flames
entries.text: Inflicts "Woe's Whisper" on all enemies, lasting for **3** turn(s). Enemy targets under the "Woe's Whisper" state take **16%** increased DMG. Deals **100%** Physical Elation DMG to all enemies. Then, deals **5** instance(s) of **20%** Physical Elation DMG to one random enemy.

entries.name: Amaze-In Grace
entries.text: When Yao Guang's SPD is **120** or higher, increases this unit's Elation by **30%**. For every **1** SPD exceeded, increases this unit's Elation by **1%**. Up to a max of **200** excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

entries.name: Poised and Sated
entries.text: Increases this unit's CRIT DMG by **60%**. After using Elation Skill, recovers **1** Skill Point(s) for the team.

entries.name: Felicity Ensemble
entries.text: When Yao Guang gains "Certified Banger," its duration increases by **1** turn(s).

entries.name: Chuckle Chimes Where Jade Falls
entries.text: In Aha's extra turn triggered by Ultimate, the fixed amount of Punchline taken into account increases to 40. When dealing Elation DMG, all ally targets ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

entries.name: Blind Arrows Guided by Feathers
entries.text: While the Zone is active, increases all ally targets' SPD by 12%, and additionally increases Elation by 16%.

entries.name: Auspices Mirrored In Decalight
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Threads of Fate Colored by Plumes
entries.text: In Aha's extra turn triggered by Yao Guang's Ultimate, the DMG dealt by all ally characters' Elation Skill becomes 150% of the original DMG.

entries.name: Bejeweled in Radiant Grace
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Ferried Along the Astral Arc
entries.text: All ally targets' Elation DMG merrymakes by 25%. Increases the DMG multiplier of Yao Guang's Elation Skill by 100% of its original multiplier.
